edits.old: Then it holds account and case references, codes, dates and counts only
edits.new:
Then it holds account and case references, codes, dates and counts only

  Scenario: AC7 A provided operation answers an error with 401, 403 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller sends no valid credential, lacks Reporting R on the read, or asks for a reported row that does not exist
    When the caller reads the reported rows
    Then the caller gets 401, 403 or 404 respectively with the refusal and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC8 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stops the step (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rule-version read of rwb-decision does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the classification step runs
    Then the step stops, the reported rows of the date stay as they were and the user sees MSG-GEN-006

| TC-E8-002-10 | Access and status (AC7) | Contract | A request with no valid credential, a caller without Reporting R and a request for a missing reported row answer 401, 403 and 404; nothing changes |
| TC-E8-002-11 | Failed call (AC8, X2) | Component | The rwb-decision read does not answer inside 2 s, and separately its breaker is open; the step stops, the reported rows keep their values and MSG-GEN-006 is returned |
| TC-E8-002-12 | Publish guard (AC1, X5, BR5) | Component | A PUBLISHED or frozen business date receives a late change; no row is rewritten and the change is written for the next unpublished date with both dates in the record |
| TC-E8-002-13 | Stale product (AC1, X6, BR7) | Component | A data product behind the case facts is stale for the business date; its rows keep their own business date, show it as stale and MSG-P1-001 is shown |
